items.lede: General Motors has agreed to pay $220 million to settle claims that it illegally sold driver and location information to data brokers, as reported earlier by Reuters. items.title: GM to pay $220 million to resolve claims it sold driving habits data

items.lede: As part of the settlement, GM must get drivers’ express consent before it collects or shares their driving and location data.
